name: kiro
description: Cost-saving delegation: the current host plans and verifies; Kiro CLI implements in isolated worktrees and optionally reviews changes before commits.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate implementation to Kiro CLI to save tokens.
interface.longDescription: Use Codex to plan, configure and verify Kiro worktree delegation or read-only review. Shared commit/push hooks preserve opt-in review behavior. Check captured changes and tests before landing them.
